name: ws2812b_strip_1m_60
title: WS2812B strip, 1 m, 60 a metre
description: 60 WS2812B on a flexible strip, one data line through all of them: the end of the strip goes on into the next one

strip.notes: The garland of ~/git/led_strip: a strip of 5 m and one of 1 m in a row, 360 LEDs on one data line of an ESP32, fed from a supply of their own. The volts are those of the WS2812B.
